sheets.name: natural-habits
sheets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent character animation sprite sheet, NOT a website mockup.
Input image 1 is CHARACTER IDENTITY REFERENCE only. Recreate exactly its perched Mochi owl from the bottom row: big dark teal round eyes with small white highlights, cream heart-like face, tiny dark triangular beak, swept green brow/ear feathers, richly layered green LEAF feathers, short green tail leaning to viewer-left, two tiny orange feet. Match its polished softly shaded 2D cut-paper illustration, palette, lighting, face-to-body proportions. No redesign, no added clothing/accessories.
Output: 2048x2048 square PNG with REAL TRANSPARENT background, exactly 4 equal columns and 4 equal rows, 16 fully isolated full-body poses. One owl per cell, ordered row-major. No text, labels, grid lines, symbols, floor, cast shadow, watermark, magenta or checkerboard drawn into artwork. No cropping or overlap. Same full-body size and neutral camera in EVERY cell. Within each cell, center chest at x50% y52%, normal planted toes at y85%; ears normally at y17%. Leave ample transparent padding. Feet remain anchored except where movement specified. Change anatomy for head/wing/eye motions, not the whole canvas. Each row is one short readable action with 4 successive keyframes.
Sheet 1 of 5: NATURAL HABITS.
ROW 1 HEAD TILT: 1 neutral forward gaze; 2 head ONLY tilts 12 degrees to viewer-left with body upright; 3 head ONLY tilts 15 degrees to viewer-right curiously; 4 returns upright with a soft blink.
ROW 2 BREATHING: 1 calm neutral perch; 2 chest leaf feathers gently expand for inhale, feet planted; 3 chest feathers softly settle in exhale with eyes relaxed; 4 returns neutral. Subtle but distinguishable.
ROW 3 FEATHER PUFF / SHAKE: 1 crouch slightly with feathers compressed; 2 round fluffy chest and cheek feathers puff outward; 3 feathers ruffle asymmetrically during quick shake with closed content eyes; 4 sleek settled neutral feathers, bright eyes.
ROW 4 PREEN: 1 looks down toward its own wing; 2 head turns and beak tucks into raised shoulder feathers; 3 eyes closed while smoothing the leaf-feather tips with beak; 4 lifts head upright looking pleased.
CONSISTENCY: same exact green owl in all cells, same face proportions and foot scale as reference. Transparent background. Do not draw flight poses.
